question.problem: The formula for the $n$th term of an arithmetic sequence is ${a}_{n}=5n+8$ for $n\ge 1.$  What is the recursive formula for this sequence?
question.worked_solution:
The recursive formula for an arithmetic sequence is as follows:

$$
{a}_{n+1}={a}_{n}+d,\,{a}_{1}=___\,,\,n\ge 1
$$

To complete the formula, we need to work out the first term and common difference. The first two terms are

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1} & =5(1)+8=13 \\ {a}_{2} & =5(2)+8=18\end{aligned}
$$

and the common difference is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={a}_{2}-{a}_{1} \\  & =18-13 \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the first term is ${a}_{1}=13$ and the common difference is $d=5.$ Therefore, the recursive formula is as follows:

$$
{a}_{n+1}={a}_{n}+5,\,{a}_{1}=13,\,n\ge 1
$$
